# ModerateAI

ModerateAI is AI customer support and community moderation software for Website, Discord, and Telegram.
It helps teams automate repetitive support, capture qualified leads, and keep moderation policies consistent.

## Quick Facts
- ModerateAI supports Website, Discord, and Telegram in one workspace.
- ModerateAI combines AI support, lead capture, and moderation operations.
- Standard and Pro plans are activated by support after payment verification.
